messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed a weird jump in p99 for /v1/generate after yesterday's routing weight reshuffle. p50/p95 stable, p99 +220ms. Anyone else seeing this?
monitoring-bot: alert: endpoint:/v1/generate p99 increased above threshold (baseline 360ms -> 580ms) — triggered 09:17 UTC
sam: yup saw the alert. looks correlated with the route-weight change at 08:45. is this a real tail or sampling artifact?
luis: quick question — are these server-side percentiles (gateway measured) or client-side? could be sample origin mismatch.
mike: gateway (server) percents. I pulled raw histograms from collector: more heavy tails on some origin tags. Will paste short grep.
mike: ```
# top origins by p99 delta
origin=routeA -> p99_delta=+310ms
origin=routeB -> p99_delta=+10ms
origin=routeC -> p99_delta=-5ms
```
anya: routeA got a bigger weight towards the new dedicated pool. that pool is on g5x2 with a different batching config. maybe batching/kv cache interaction?
sam: good call. batching changes often move the tail. did we change batch timeout or max-batch?
mike: batch config on dedicated-pool-A: max_batch_tokens=4096, batch_wait_ms=6 (old was 3). changed in rollout.
luis: doubling wait can increase latency variance for single-request flows. but why only p99, not p95? suggests a small fraction of requests waiting extra cycles.
anya: could also be cold KV cache misses: new pool yesterday didn't prewarm prefix cache. a few long requests that miss KV cache blow up p99.
sam: can we correlate requests with kv_cache_hit=false?
mike: doing that now. short query: `sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket{endpoint="/v1/generate",kv_cache_hit="false"}[5m]))` — will post counts in a min.
monitoring-bot: notification: rollout:duty:route-weight-change by release/2026-03-20 at 08:44 UTC
mike: raw counts: kv_cache_hit=false p99 ~1.2s for routeA, kv_cache_hit=true p99 ~470ms. volume of cache-miss tails ~0.8% of traffic to routeA.
luis: that aligns: small fraction of cold misses -> big p99 bump. solution: prewarm or reduce batch_wait for that pool OR surface p50/p95/p99 split by kv_cache tag on dashboard.
anya: agree. UX ask: console should let us toggle percentile provenance (sample origin, cache-hit, route) quickly. currently need custom query.
sam: pragmatic immediate fix: revert batch_wait to 3ms on pool-A and prewarm top prefixes. also add a temporary tag in metrics so dashboard can show breakdown by kv_cache_hit.
mike: I'll rollback batch_wait in config and trigger prewarm script. prewarm script: `scripts/prewarm-prefixes --pool=pool-A --prefix-file=suspect-prefixes.txt`
luis: long-term we should change the endpoint rollup to include metadata provenance links — hover -> shows top contributing tags for the percentile.
anya: filed a tiny console UX ticket for provenance toggle (product backlog) — #prod-ux drop-in. cc @sam for priority.
sam: thanks. after rollback and prewarm I'll watch p99 for 30m and report.
monitoring-bot: note: created incident stub INC-2026-034 (investigate p99 spike /v1/generate)
mike: rollback applied 09:36 UTC. prewarm kicked off; estimated 2m to finish.
anya: awesome — mike, can you post delta in 15m?
mike: sure. initial post-rollback p99 down to 410ms at 09:40. prewarm still working.
luis: propose small console improvement: when routes change weight, surface a checklist: "verify KV prewarm / batch config parity / metric provenance". would have caught this.
anya: +1. add to runbook for routing changes.
sam: follow-up: we should also add a low-traffic-sample alert that watches absolute p99 change with small sample sets (if <1% of traffic, expect noisier p99). uncertain thresholds though.
luis: maybe use quantile stability heuristic: ignore p99 shifts if sample_count < N in window, or surface a warning.
anya: created short follow-ups: 1) runbook checklist PR 2) dashboard provenance toggle 3) sampling-based p99 noise filter alert. assigning owners.
mike: p99 holding at 420ms after prewarm. will observe for 1h.
sam: great — thanks team. small learnings: routing policy + infra divergence (batching & cache) -> tail spikes. need better console signals. :mag:
anya: thanks all. closing thread after 1h stable. :white_check_mark:
